description: Detection rules for Linux authentication events (SSH, sudo, PAM)

rules.name: Multiple Failed SSH Logins
rules.description: Detects 5+ failed SSH login attempts from the same IP within 60 seconds

rules.name: SSH Brute Force
rules.description: Detects 10+ failed SSH login attempts from same IP within 120 seconds

rules.name: Successful Login After Multiple Failures
rules.description: Successful SSH login from an IP that had recent failed attempts

rules.name: Invalid User Login Attempts
rules.description: Login attempt using a non-existent username

rules.name: Suspicious sudo Activity
rules.description: Multiple sudo failures from the same user in short time

rules.name: Privilege Escalation Indicator
rules.description: sudo to root by non-privileged user shortly after login

rules.name: Repeated Authentication Failures
rules.description: PAM reports repeated auth failures across services
